85
Oathkeeper
Passively grants +40 Airborne Effectiveness and +10 Draw Time to Bows.
+10 Draw Time is equivalent to Draw Time Masterwork.

Bows can hold perfect draws indefinitely.

After 0.35 seconds of reaching full draw on a Primary Ammo Bow:
Grants increased damage every 0.5 seconds, up to 200% increased impact damage against Combatants after 2 seconds.
Broadhead, Poison, Stasis Crystals, Dragonfly/Explosive Head, and others are not affected.
Damage Buff disappears after holding full draw for 4 seconds.Mk. 44 Stand Asides
While Juggernaut's Shield is active:
Grants a stack of Bolt Charge every 1.5 seconds.

While Speed Booster is active:
Creates an area behind the user that grants allies Speed Booster.Phoenix Protocol
While inside your Well of Radiance, while under 50% Super Energy, and if your Super Ability is Well of Radiance:
Grants 10% Super Energy per kill.

Amount of Super Energy gained is decreased by 1.5% for each successive kill, down to a minimum of 4% Super Energy per kill.

10% -> 8.5% -> 7% -> 5% -> 4.5% -> 4% -> 4%...
